items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The main purpose was to get Dorothy Lamour out of the sarong, or out that plot.

ctx.x: Yeah. I figured it was one of the naked-as-you-go pictures. The main purpose was to get Dorothy Lamour out of the sarong, or out that plot. I think we had a skeleton of a plot. But anyway --
You mean out of it and into something else or just out of it?
